title: Node Random Example Bound
statement: For every natural number $n$, every subset $P\subseteq[n]$, and all natural numbers $k,b$, the node's random-example count for $P$, using failure parameter $\delta_{k,b}$, is at most $A_k(n+1)^{\lfloor 3k/4\rfloor+3}(b+1)$. Define $T_0=1$, $T_{j+1}=1+2T_j$, $c_k=\lfloor3k/4\rfloor$, $d_k=k-c_k$, $L_k=\lceil\log_2 T_k\rceil+2(c_k+1)+5$, $B_k=(c_k+1)(36\cdot4^kL_k)+2^{d_k}(d_k+1+L_k)$, and $A_k=2^{k+1}B_k+16\cdot4^kL_k$; the per-call failure parameter is $\delta_{k,b}=T_k^{-1}2^{-(b+1)}$, and the node's random-example count uses the restriction sample count with failure parameter $\delta_{k,b}/2$.
hypotheses_covered: the failure parameter is the specified dyadic per-call failure parameter
